checks.name: Matches repeated Kannada, including combining vowel marks
Case, punctuation and pronunciation variants match
Known-language reading of an option matches without treating it as a new question
Negated or different requests do not match exactly
A transcription typo is ambiguous, not silently suppressed
Short common phrases require a speaker decision
No matches across conversations, profiles, languages, expired or future suggestions
Only the latest applicable reply set is used
The options actually displayed take priority over a newer hidden result
Without both speaker anchors, identity remains unknown
Separated anchors identify a matching speaker
Speaker samples expire and clear between sessions
Silence does not create a voice identity
Voice frames are bounded and raw PCM is not retained
